notes: v2.9.78 BUYING-POWER RETRY: Fixes the live auto-trading stop seen after Kiwoom [2000] buying-power rejections. When Kiwoom explicitly says N shares are buyable, PUMA now retries once with that exact affordable quantity and records/manages the adjusted quantity. Deterministic buying-power rejections no longer call stop_auto(); the engine stays enabled and continues scanning other candidates. Only genuinely ambiguous order/cancel transport failures still trigger the duplicate-order safety stop. Trading-selection logic remains unchanged.
